sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Kashmiri Yellow Lotus Elephant Meenakari Bracelet Watch
sourceNotes.rawContent: Vibrant, joyful, and rooted in Indian folk art — this unique Kashmiri bracelet watch features bright yellow lotus flower charms with green leaf accents flanking a pearl-bordered white quartz dial, leading to an adorable green meenakari elephant pendant with cascading ghungroo chains. A truly festive and one-of-a-kind piece that celebrates the colours and symbols of Indian heritage. Perfect for Haldi ceremonies, Navratri, folk-themed events, and gifting.
